packageRules.description: Let a fresh npm release settle before proposing it — a compromised publish is usually yanked within a day or two. Security fixes bypass this via the vulnerabilityAlerts block below.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes must not wait for a human to tick a box on the dependency dashboard. sanitize-html, matrix-js-sdk, pdfjs-dist, html-dom-parser and slate all parse attacker-controlled input from arbitrary homeservers; an unapplied patch there is directly exploitable. Routine version bumps stay gated by :dependencyDashboardApproval.

npm.description: DISABLED 2026-08-11. Renovate is not installed on this repository — no Renovate PRs, no Renovate branches — and Issues are disabled, so the dependency dashboard that `:dependencyDashboardApproval` gates every routine npm update behind cannot be created. Everything above about npm was therefore inert, and 22 advisories accumulated (see DEPENDENCY_AUDIT.md §1). npm now belongs to Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml). If you install the Renovate app and want it back, re-enable this AND remove the npm ecosystem from dependabot.yml in the same change — never run both on one manifest.

github-actions.description: Owned by Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) so the two bots never open competing PRs for the same manifest.
